csv_project_name: A/E Service for Sierra Vista Municipal Airport
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Sierra Vista, Arizona requests statements of qualifications from qualified airport architectural/engineering consulting firms for the scoping, design, bidding/negotiation, and construction administration services associated with several planned projects at the Sierra Vista Municipal Airport. Responses will be used to short-list firms who will then be invited to enter negotiations/respond to a formal Request for Proposal. The City is seeking to award a three (3) year contract with one (1) two-year option period to the highest ranked firm. The CoSV desires to secure the professional services of a qualified airport engineering and/or architectural consulting firm for the scoping, design, bidding/negotiation, and construction administration for potential projects at FHU. The following list of potential projects is illustrative only and will depend on available funding. Future potential projects may include: Install new AWOS sensors ($400,000) Design and construction of a pavement preservation project on Runway 12-30 and a connector taxiway to Runway 30 ($1,670,000) Design and construction of a pavement rehabilitation project on the concrete apron ($1,400,000) Design and construction of access, parking, aprons, taxiways, and utility improvements to support landside development on the north side of the Airport ($8,000,000) Design and construction of general pavement maintenance identified in the ADOT Pavement Assessment ($2,500,000) Install MALSF on Runway 26 ($1,000,000) Install REILs on Runways 26 and 12, and 30 ($1,950,000)
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Transportation Planning

title: A/E Services for Sierra Vista Municipal Airport
short_description: Airport engineering and architectural services for multiple airside and landside improvement projects.
project_location: Sierra Vista Municipal Airport, Sierra Vista, Arizona, USA
project_scope: Multi-project airport improvement program at Sierra Vista Municipal Airport (FHU) under a 3-year contract with one 2-year renewal option. Illustrative projects include new AWOS sensors; pavement preservation on Runway 12-30 and a connector taxiway to Runway 30; pavement rehabilitation of the concrete apron; access, parking, apron, taxiway, and utility improvements for north-side landside development; general pavement maintenance identified in the ADOT Pavement Assessment; installation of MALSF on Runway 26; and installation of REILs on Runways 26, 12, and 30.
services: Airport architectural and engineering consulting services for scoping, design, bidding/negotiation, and construction administration. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an airport infrastructure and multidisciplinary A/E framework-style services contract, not focused on bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, or architecturally demanding buildings.
- Main listed works are pavements, lighting/navigation aids, utilities, parking, and airside/landside improvements.
- Includes design services, but no clear structural engineering scope aligned with sbp core strengths.
- Renewable multi-year contract for various future projects reduces technical specificity.
- Could contain isolated structural elements in later phases, but none are defined in the notice.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated by summing the listed illustrative project budgets in the tender documents: 400,000 + 1,670,000 + 1,400,000 + 8,000,000 + 2,500,000 + 1,000,000 + 1,950,000 = 16,920,000 USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. The notice is for a qualifications-based selection for a multi-year airport A/E contract covering several potential projects funded by FAA grants.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications are requested from qualified airport architectural/engineering consulting firms. The notice indicates firms will be shortlisted and highest-ranked firm selected, but no detailed minimum reference counts or specific qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Highest ranked firm after qualifications-based shortlisting; shortlisted firms may be invited to negotiations or a formal RFP. Detailed weighted award criteria are not stated in the provided text.
